system.description: You were raised among traders, performers, pilgrims, nomads, couriers, or traveling families for whom roads and temporary camps were home. Constant exposure to unfamiliar places taught you how to pick up new practices quickly.

legacy.name: Lessons of the Road
legacy.text: At the beginning of each Adventure, choose one Non-Combat Skill you do not possess. Treat that Skill as Rank 1 until the Adventure ends.

familiarity.name: Road Lore
familiarity.text: You recognize traveler marks, route warnings, regional accents, common road hazards, and signs that a path is less safe than it appears. In an unfamiliar settlement, you can quickly locate places where outsiders arrange passage, seek work, exchange news, and trade informal favors.
